summary: Track spending without handing over bank logins or sharing data with third parties, with working account deletion and no AI features.

evidence.claim: 9 dated complaints (2026-05 to 2026-11) about data selling, bank-login requests, account deletion not working and unwanted AI, across 5 apps (Monarch, Copilot, Rocket Money, MonoBoost, Bills Manager)
evidence.source: state/scout/2026-11-17-finance.json (fin-c4; each quote has an Apple review RSS URL and date)

scores.note: marginal. Complaints are reviewer claims about data practices, not verified against privacy policies. Demand is mixed: a Spendee reviewer wants bank linking. Without linking, the job relies on manual entry or statement import; the spec must show that is acceptable. Avoid any claim about competitors' practices.

history.note: kept, marginal: 9 complaints, 5 apps, claims unverified
